item.title: Girls soccer: Terra Linda advances to first section final in program history
item.description: The Terra Linda High girls soccer team took to its home field on Wednesday knowing that a victory would secure passage into the first section final in program history. The Trojans met that big moment with a composed performance, scoring a goal midway through the first half and limiting Rancho Cotate to a few half-chances […]
